lines: Giant
「Hmm, three women. It appears you've gained one. Very well.」
After looking the three of them over briefly, the giant dressed as a warrior monk, who looked like he had escaped from a kabuki play, set his eyes sharply on Asuka.
Benkei
「My name is Senjuin Benkei. I have very much wanted to meet you, Steel Reaper!!」
He gave his name with such a fierce voice that it echoed across the runway.
And, with Asuka's nickname attached.
Lena
「S-Steel Reaper?!」
Tomoe
「The cyborg Taimanin?!」
Lena and Tomoe looked at her like they were shocked.
Asuka
Naturally, she couldn't hide her true identity any longer.
Asuka
「H-Hi. I'm Koukawa Asuka.」
She made a slightly awkward greeting, with a bow.
Tomoe
「Koukawa Asuka of the DSO. I've heard of you.」
Tomoe was nodding understandingly.
Lena
「Mmmmmm...」
Lena looked like she wanted to say something.
Her face said, 「So you weren't just a wind user passing by?」, but it looked like she had decided to shut her mouth for now, out of vigilance towards Benkei.
Because of that, Asuka also looked in Benkei's direction.
Since he had given his name so brazenly, she naturally remembered.
Above all, there was that rosary hanging from his neck.
Asuka
「I know of you, too. Senjuin Benkei, the Cyborg Hunter.」
Asuka
「They say you string the heads of cyborgs you've defeated into a rosary. Nasty little hobby.」
Lena
「Wha?! He does horrible stuff like that?!」
Tomoe
「What the hell? That's the peak of wickedness. You ought to be ashamed of yourself!」
Benkei
「Fuhahahahahaha! Strength is something you obtain by honing your own body!」
Benkei
「I accept no cyborg who believes they've gotten strong simply through the likes of machinery!」
Asuka
「So that's why you killed your cyborg allies too?!」
Benkei
「Those obstacles are gone, and good riddance to them. Your head, too, I shall rip off and hang from here.」
Benkei gently, amusedly stroked the skulls of his victims, which dangled from his neck.
Asuka
「Oh, really? I've just started wanting to pull your head off, myself.」
The wind began to blow around Asuka.
In addition to having readily killed his own allies, for him to claim that she had gotten stronger simply with machines... She couldn't contain her anger.
Benkei
「You two over there should pull back. Should you interfere in my single-combat duel with that cyborg, I will not have mercy.」
Benkei began to slowly swing around the metal bat that had pulverized his allies.
Tomoe
「Shut up! As a Taimanin, I can't tolerate a criminal like you!」
Lena
「Same for me. As a Hell Knight of Nomad, I'm gonna punish you!!」
Benkei
「Taimanin and Hell Knight, you say? Guhahaha! How amusing!! Then, all three of you may come at me at once!!」
Asuka
「We'll do just that, you rotten miscreant!!」
